title: project-tree-md --json output
description: One directory tree, after the same filtering as the Markdown output. Fields may be added within schema version 1; removing or changing one bumps the version.

path.description: Absolute path of the directory that was read, as given (a symlink given here is followed, and root is its target directory under the link's name).

counts.description: Entries listed below the root, not counting the root itself.

files.description: Everything that isn't a directory: files, symlinks and other entries.

problems.description: Directories below the root, or symlink targets, that couldn't be read. Not empty means the exit code is 1.

path.description: Relative to the root, with forward slashes.

target.description: Symlinks only: the link's target as stored. Symlinks inside the tree are not followed.

children.description: Directories only, sorted directories first, then by name ignoring case. Absent when the directory is truncated or unreadable.

truncated.description: true when --depth stopped before this directory's contents. They were not read.

error.description: Set when this directory, or this symlink's target, couldn't be read.
